items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries.
items.why: Foot/ankle; exited prior game after being stepped on; coach priority to get healthy.
items.implication: Monitor closely; possible GTD or OUT elevates Chris Rodriguez handcuff path.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Rodriguez early-down/goal-line bump; Etienne committee dynamics.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker III for Thursday Night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson will start for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin; limited Mon/Tue then DNP Wed; short week caution after missing prior two.
items.implication: Emmett Johnson inherits lead role again as RB1 upside in potentially high-scoring TNF.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full carry/target share for Johnson; reverse prior Walker stashes.

items.text: Packers list RB Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable for Wed night vs Rams; coach LaFleur has repeatedly said unlikely to play post-surgery.
items.why: Finger surgery ~12 days prior; grip concerns; limited practice but expected sit.
items.implication: Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd lead committee again; limited Packers run game volume.
items.opportunity: Early-down for Kaleb Johnson; pass-downs Lloyd; low overall RB ceiling.

items.text: Berry LOVEs Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more FPPG among RBs, and now faces Carolina.
items.why: Elite recent FPPG pace plus soft CAR matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; high floor/ceiling in PPR.

items.text: Berry HATEs Bo Nix this week: expects heavy Jonah Coleman usage vs Pittsburgh and hasn't seen enough rushing from Nix; ranks outside top 20.
items.why: Run-heavy script expected; limited Nix rush production.

items.text: Levitan on Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17 schedule.
items.why: Citing Graziano reporting; snap/route share risk vs carry floor + playoff schedule.
items.implication: RB2/flex with carry-based floor; not pure receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Carry volume + soft late schedule; monitor Tuten status impact.

items.text: With Jacoby Brissett, Derrick Henry target share jumped from <6% (1.3 rec/g) to 12% and 4.5 receptions over two games, raising PPR floor.
items.why: Brissett checkdowns spike receiving volume vs prior low-aDOT/low-share role.
items.implication: UPGRADE floor in PPR; start with more confidence even if concussion protocol clears.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11; season avg 36% with 50% of Eagles end-zone targets; role elite despite injuries tanking overall season.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 when active; RIDE OR DIE role realization.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts and <10% targets often since Dowdle return (RB20 util); D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes and low targets with Monangai back — both mid/low RB2s now.
items.implication: Fade from RB1 to RB2/flex; lower floors.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson out for the season; also Colts cut Daniel Jones with AR set to start; Tuten injury resurfaces.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups/ROS; Kyren/Corum/Adams timelines separate.
items.opportunity: LAR WR/TE vacuum already priced; monitor Adams return longshot.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy won't practice Wednesday with ankle sprain from SN F; Shanahan says day-to-day.
items.why: Low ankle sprain sustained Week 11 Q2.
items.implication: Monitor; not expected major miss risk yet but watch Friday report.
items.opportunity: If limited, 49ers skill (CMC/Kittle) script may shift slightly.

items.text: Ladd McConkey return: season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FPTS last week; when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG.
items.why: Snap/target spike on return; prior efficiency when involved.

items.text: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) last two with Beck/Johnson but 3-yard aDOT, only 1 of 19 targets 10+ air yards; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but 6.5 YPR/11.8 FPPG avg.
items.why: High volume, extreme short-area targets without Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 but not elite ceiling.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka dead last in YPT (5.0) among 45 WRs with 50+ targets; under 50 rec yds since Week 3 and under 12 PPR in 17 of last 20 games.
items.why: Efficiency collapse + inconsistent QB; far from early-rookie form.
